def check(q, s):
    (X, y, M, l0, l2) = (q[k] for k in ('X', 'y', 'M', 'lam0', 'lam2'))
    w = s['weights']
    ub = s['objective']
    lb = s['certified_lower_bound']
    p = X.shape[1]
    leaves = s['subcube_leaves']
    G = X.T @ X
    assert np.all(np.isfinite(w)) and w.shape == (p,) and (max(abs(w)) <= M + 1e-12)
    assert abs(ub - (0.5 * np.linalg.norm(X @ w - y) ** 2 + 0.5 * l2 * (w @ w) + l0 * sum(abs(w) > 1e-08))) < 1e-09
    assert 1 <= len(leaves) <= 2048 and 0 <= ub - lb <= 1e-05
    cubes = []
    vol = 0
    max_over = -np.inf
    min_eig = np.inf
    for leaf in leaves:
        (z, a) = (np.asarray(leaf[k]) for k in ('fixed_zero', 'fixed_active'))
        assert a.shape == z.shape == (p,) and (not np.any(z & a))
        if 'dual_nu' in leaf:
            nu = leaf['dual_nu']
            cst = nu @ y - 0.5 * (nu @ nu)
            h = abs(X.T @ nu)
            qq = l2
        else:
            (d, c) = (leaf['minorant_diagonal'], leaf['minorant_center'])
            e = np.linalg.eigvalsh(G - np.diag(d))[0]
            min_eig = min(min_eig, e)
            assert min(d) >= 0 and e >= -1e-10
            r = y - X @ c
            cst = 0.5 * (r @ r) + r @ (X @ c) + 0.5 * (d * c @ c)
            h = abs(X.T @ r + d * c)
            qq = l2 + d
        b = np.minimum(M, h / qq)
        on = l0 - b * (h - 0.5 * qq * b)
        val = cst + on[a].sum() + np.minimum(0, on[~(a | z)]).sum()
        max_over = max(max_over, leaf['lb'] - val)
        assert leaf['lb'] <= val + 1e-09 and lb <= leaf['lb'] + 1e-06
        zi = sum((1 << int(j) for j in np.flatnonzero(z)))
        ai = sum((1 << int(j) for j in np.flatnonzero(a)))
        assert all((zi & aj or ai & zj for (zj, aj) in cubes))
        cubes.append((zi, ai))
        vol += 1 << p - int(sum(z | a))
    assert vol == 1 << p
    return (ub - lb, len(leaves), min_eig, max_over)
